confirmation.dispatch: public-confirmation-context-v1 hashed contexts; adjacent P/E pair; alternate first arm

confirmation_statistics.quality_comparison: exact final complete energy P versus E; no epsilon or rounded quality ties
confirmation_statistics.PF_saving_claim_rule: all 24 exact complete-energy pairs P>=E and primary PF ratio percentile interval upper bound strictly <1
confirmation_statistics.missing: retain all frozen rows and nulls; any missing suppresses that group mean, ratio and interval; no imputation or complete-case estimates
confirmation_statistics.incomplete_status_export: all 48 frozen identities; controller exits and raw cost snapshots only, explicitly unverified; no quality read or full-population estimand

bootstrap.resampling: independent with-replacement draws of sorted fault and event labels, Cartesian multiplicity weights, same weights for P and E
bootstrap.undefined_replicates: retain count and suppress entire interval; never discard or redraw

confirmation_statistics.time: complete cold process seconds; one run per arm/context, descriptive machine-dependent secondary endpoint
confirmation_statistics.inference_limit: four fault clusters and six event clusters; not 24 independent replications; intervals exploratory, no p-value or guaranteed generalization
